messages.output_raw: Need to check if my Southwest flight left on time. Looking back after the fact.

</think>
<plan>
1. Ask user for the specific flight details needed to look up status
2. Once provided, call get_flight_status with those details
3. Report whether it departed on time, including scheduled vs actual times
</plan>

Share those and I’ll check whether it departed on time and what the actual times were.</action>
